attr-grit.title: Grit
attr-grit.text: Your physical body. The resilience and power of flesh and bone.

attr-reflex.title: Reflex
attr-reflex.text: Your uncontrolled impulses. The precise senses and natural instincts.

attr-intellect.title: Intellect
attr-intellect.text: Your pointed mind. The library of knowledge and its application.

attr-psyche.title: Psyche
attr-psyche.text: Your own soul. The internal will and the poetry to communicate it.

skill-athletics.title: Athletics
skill-athletics.text: Raw physicality. Your ability to influence the world with your body’s power.

skill-brawling.title: Brawling
skill-brawling.text: Hand-to-hand combat. Your unarmed combat prowess and the ability to intimidate others.

skill-endurance.title: Endurance
skill-endurance.text: Bodily resilience. Your ability to withstand pain and various harsh conditions.

skill-dexterity.title: Dexterity
skill-dexterity.text: Balance and coordination. Your ability to perform elegant and acrobatic movements.

skill-perception.title: Perception
skill-perception.text: The senses. Your ability to detect things in your surroundings.

skill-stealth.title: Stealth
skill-stealth.text: Elusiveness. Your ability to hide from others and pass unnoticed.

skill-knowledge.title: Knowledge
skill-knowledge.text: The encyclopedia of facts. Your ability to recall basic information about the world.

skill-reasoning.title: Reasoning
skill-reasoning.text: Critical thinking. Your ability to apply logic and notice patterns.

skill-survival.title: Survival
skill-survival.text: Bodily familiarity. Your ability to perform first aid and take care of your needs.

skill-intuition.title: Intuition
skill-intuition.text: Empathy. Your ability to sense the motivations of others.

skill-persuasion.title: Persuasion
skill-persuasion.text: Charm. your ability to negotiate and barter.

skill-willpower.title: Willpower
skill-willpower.text: Mental resilience. Your ability to resist the will of others.

skill-carry.title: Carry
skill-carry.text: Back strength. Your ability to carry heavy items and armour over a prolonged period.

skill-discipline.title: Discipline
skill-discipline.text: Nerve and courage. Your ability to maintain a clear mind under physical pressure and duress.

skill-stance.title: Stance
skill-stance.text: Posture. your ability to grip items and avoid tripping.

skill-interface.title: Interface
skill-interface.text: Sleight of hand. Your ability to perform precise hand movements like lockpicking.

skill-pilot.title: Pilot
skill-pilot.text: Systemic coordination. Your ability to operate vehicles and siege weapons.

skill-scout.title: Scout
skill-scout.text: Worldly navigation. Your ability to survey and quickly traverse areas.

skill-engineering.title: Engineering
skill-engineering.text: Advanced problem solving. Your ability to apply scientific principles to complex tasks and craft items.

skill-lore.title: Lore
skill-lore.text: Studied narratives. Your knowledge of the world’s history, geography and the humanities.

skill-medicine.title: Medicine
skill-medicine.text: Anatomy and herbalism. Your ability to mend injuries and brew concoctions.

skill-authority.title: Authority
skill-authority.text: Soft force. Your ability to impose your will onto others.

skill-deception.title: Deception
skill-deception.text: Dishonesty and composure. Your ability to lie and manipulate others.

skill-whisper.title: Whisper
skill-whisper.text: Planar entanglement. Your ability to interact with non-humans and the unknowable.

status-pierce.title: Pierce X
status-pierce.text: The attack inflicting this effect applies to bypasses up to X points of armour on a successful hit.

status-break.title: Break X
status-break.text: The attack inflicting this effect depletes X points of armour on a successful hit.

status-stun.title: Stun X
status-stun.text: Afflicted creature has -X on combat rolls. The level of the effect is reduced by one at the end of the creature’s turn and by two upon performing a defensive action.

status-bleeding.title: Bleeding X
status-bleeding.text: Afflicted creature loses X vigor at the beginning of its combat turn or once every minute. The effect can be reduced by 1 by performing a defensive action or by 2 by spending 2 AP to perform a successful survival skill check with a CL equal to 12+X. Creatures wearing unbroken medium or heavy armour or using an unbroken shield are immune to bleeding.

status-burn.title: Burn X
status-burn.text: Afflicted creature loses X vigor at the beginning of its turn. The level of the effect is reduced by one when it damages the afflicted creature and by two upon performing a defensive action. Burn deals +2 DMG to targets without armour.

status-soulburn.title: Soulburn X
status-soulburn.text: Afflicted creature loses X vigor at the beginning of its turn. The level of the effect is reduced by two upon performing a defensive action. Upon reaching 0 VG, soulburn is cleansed and Burn 1 is applied. X Temporary Vigor (TMV) - Afflicted creature has X additional vigor unaffected by armour that is depleted before the main health pool.

status-fractured.title: Fractured X
status-fractured.text: Afflicted creature’s abilities cost +1 AP to perform. The level of the effect is reduced by 1 at the end of the afflicted creature’s turn or by 2 upon performing a defensive action and succeeding a CL 12+X discipline skill check.

status-prone.title: Prone
status-prone.text: Afflicted creature loses its reaction for this turn. At the start of its next turn, it loses 2 AP and its movement action.

status-feeble.title: Feeble X
status-feeble.text: Afflicted creature deals -X DMG during its next turn.

status-blind.title: Blind X
status-blind.text: Afflicted creature suffers -8 ACC on all ranged attacks and abilities during its next X turns.

status-immobilized.title: Immobilized X
status-immobilized.text: Afflicted creature is unable to move during its next X turns.

status-stealth.title: Stealth
status-stealth.text: Other creatures are Unaware of the creature that is in Stealth. This effect is lost upon entering a creature’s line of sight or performing an attack within their line of sight.

status-taunted.title: Taunted
status-taunted.text: Afflicted creature has -2 on all attacks not targeting the creature that inflicted taunt during its next 2 turns.

status-intimidated.title: Intimidated
status-intimidated.text: Afflicted creature has -2 on all attacks targeting the creature that inflicted taunt during its next 2 turns.

status-pull.title: Pull X
status-pull.text: Moves the target X tiles towards you.

status-push.title: Push X
status-push.text: Moves the target X tiles away from you.

action-dodge.title: Dodge
action-dodge.text: Gain EVA equal to your Dexterity/2, rounded down, until the end of your turn.

action-brace.title: Brace
action-brace.text: Your armour points are increased by your Endurance/2, rounded down, until the end of your turn.

action-reload-switch.title: Reload/Switch
action-reload-switch.text: Reload your currently equipped weapon, switch your equipped weapon or pick up an object from the ground.

action-interact-consumable.title: Interact/Consumable
action-interact-consumable.text: Perform a skill check while interacting with the environment or use a consumable item on yourself or an adjacent target.

class-berserker.title: Berserker
class-berserker.text: The guard had been mocking him for the past hour. Having drunk a sufficient quantity of absinthe, he was ready to return the favour. First, he swung his crude mace directly at his plated chest, denting the armour plates towards him and breaking his ribcage. As the guard fell to his knees, gasping for air, he aligned his arms for another swing, blowing apart the guard’s horrified, gasping face onto

class-berserker-reckless-abandon.title: Reckless Abandon
class-berserker-reckless-abandon.text: Whenever you perform an attack, you may have it deal +X damage and suffer -X EVA until your next turn where X is your GRT+REF up to a maximum of 4.

class-berserker-breakthrough.title: Breakthrough
class-berserker-breakthrough.text: If this attack kills or incapacitates your target, gain an additional movement action and repeat it at no Strain cost. Breakthrough can only be repeated like this once per round.

class-berserker-rooted-blows.title: Rooted Blows
class-berserker-rooted-blows.text: Lose your movement action for this turn. Breakthrough can repeat twice upon incapacitating or killing a target this round.

class-berserker-defiant-rage.title: Defiant Rage
class-berserker-defiant-rage.text: Gain +1 ACC and +2 DMG while at half or lower of your HP max.

class-berserker-power-through.title: Power Through
class-berserker-power-through.text: Gain 3 TVG. This effect does not stack.

class-berserker-tear-muscle.title: Tear Muscle
class-berserker-tear-muscle.text: You may lose an amount of HP less than or equal to your GRT and inflict that much additional DMG on your next attack this turn. This ability may be used in place of your movement action for the turn instead.

class-berserker-bloodbath.title: Bloodbath
class-berserker-bloodbath.text: Whenever you inflict Bleeding, inflict equal Stun to enemies within C of the target (not the target themselves).

class-berserker-bloody-revelry.title: Bloody Revelry
class-berserker-bloody-revelry.text: Intimidate all bleeding enemies within your line of sight (CL 3 Willpower save). Until your next turn, roll your attacks against them with advantage.

class-berserker-spill-guts.title: Spill Guts
class-berserker-spill-guts.text: This attack may target any number of targets and gains +1 ACC for each additional target. Inflict Bleeding 2.

class-legionary.title: Legionary
class-legionary.text: He was not just another cog in the machine. His will and his might would change this broken world. Equipped with the latest and best equipment Eterion had to offer, he would tame the unreality with his virtuous comrades. His blade had been sharpened for hours. His armour shone like a bright, silvery gemstone. His shield concealed a tiny cannon, the pride and joy of his homeland’s military engineer

class-legionary-always-prepared.title: Always Prepared
class-legionary-always-prepared.text: Heal 2 Strain whenever you use a consumable item or perform an attack with a weapon you have equipped since the beginning of your previous turn. Suffer 6 Strain whenever you witness an ally being reduced to 0 HP.

class-legionary-tactical-breach.title: Tactical Breach
class-legionary-tactical-breach.text: You may freely holster any weapons and items and suffer -4 EVA until your next turn. Perform a +2 ACC attack using a newly equipped weapon or consumable that heals 2 Strain of all allies with half or more of their SL if successful.

class-legionary-solid-formation.title: Solid Formation
class-legionary-solid-formation.text: You and all allies that are in your A or are also adjacent to these allies are considered a part of your formation and cannot be flanked. Until your next turn allies in your formation gain +1 EVA and you suffer 1 Strain whenever they are damaged.

class-legionary-perfect-moment.title: Perfect Moment
class-legionary-perfect-moment.text: Each time an enemy fails to hit you or an ally within your M you gain one Perfect Moment Charge. Upon reaching the maximum of 4 Charges, you may spend them while performing Tactical Breach in order to empower it while suffering an additional -2 EVA: Bold Offensive: You and an ally of your choice gain a Temporary Destiny Point that lasts until the end of the encounter. Aligned Axis: You and an ally of your choice gain +1 AP and +2 ACC until your next turn. ●

class-legionary-measured-response.title: Measured Response
class-legionary-measured-response.text: When you perform this attack, any number of your allies may also perform it at no Strain cost. Everyone who manages to hit their target gains +3 EVA until their next turn. ●

class-legionary-secure-position.title: Secure Position
class-legionary-secure-position.text: If you have successfully performed a Tactical Breach during your previous turn, this ability costs 1 AP less to perform. Restore 4 Strain up to half of your SL maximum.

class-legionary-bound-fates.title: Bound Fates
class-legionary-bound-fates.text: You and all allies that are in your C or are also adjacent to these allies are considered a part of your formation. Abilities affecting your allies cost 1 Strain less to perform while you are in a formation with two or more allies.

class-legionary-triumphant-presence.title: Triumphant Presence
class-legionary-triumphant-presence.text: This ability additionally costs 1 Destiny Point if it has been used the previous turn. Allies within your formation gain your choice of the following until your next turn: ● +2 ACC on ranged attacks, -2 EVA ● +2 TVG, -2 tiles of movement ● +1 tile of range on melee attacks, +1 Strain cost on abilities.

class-legionary-hopebearer.title: Hopebearer
class-legionary-hopebearer.text: Whenever an attack would reduce you to 0 or less HP, an ally within your C may take that much damage +3 instead of you.

class-marksman.title: Marksman
class-marksman.text: When his village was overrun by the tall, slender stalkers, most of his neighbours tried to fight them. While some managed to wound a few, they were quickly torn apart and strung up on the nearby trees. As he watched all this from his attic hiding spot, a crossbow beside him, he fought and pleaded with his heart to show restraint, to show patience. When one of the stalkers inspected his house and

class-marksman-empowered-shot.title: Empowered Shot
class-marksman-empowered-shot.text: You gain 1 Empowered Shot Charge whenever you perform a ranged attack. Upon reaching the maximum of 3 Charges, you may spend them while performing any ranged attack in order to empower it: Volley: Repeat this attack at no Strain cost. Refresh: This attack gains +2 ACC. After performing it, heal 6 Strain if you are at half or above of your SL and reload your currently equipped weapon.

class-marksman-prepare-shot.title: Prepare Shot
class-marksman-prepare-shot.text: During your next turn, your first attack gains +X ACC where X is your class rank.

class-marksman-overwatch.title: Overwatch
class-marksman-overwatch.text: Until your next turn, gain 3 additional reactions that can be used as a ranged attack that has -1 ACC and +0 DMG. These reactions trigger upon enemy movement within your line of sight.

class-marksman-headhunter.title: Headhunter
class-marksman-headhunter.text: Whenever your ranged attack hits a target for 4 or more above their EVA, heal 2 Strain and gain a stacking +1 ranged DMG bonus that lasts until the end of the encounter. Empowered Shot gains the following option at 2 Charges: Judgement: Your next attack gains +2 ACC, +3 DMG and Pierce 3.

class-marksman-tracking-shot.title: Tracking Shot
class-marksman-tracking-shot.text: Regardless of the attack's success, you and your allies gain +1 ACC against the target for 2 rounds. This effect can reach a total of +2 ACC.

class-marksman-repel-the-savages.title: Repel The Savages
class-marksman-repel-the-savages.text: Triggers on enemy entering your M range.

class-marksman-frontline-assault.title: Frontline Assault
class-marksman-frontline-assault.text: Whenever you perform a ranged attack targeting an enemy within your C, gain +1 Empowered shot Charge. Empowered Shot gains the following option at 2 Charges: Tempo: Gain +2 EVA until your next turn. Gain an additional movement action.

class-marksman-return-fire.title: Return Fire
class-marksman-return-fire.text: Triggers on a ranged attack being used against you.

class-marksman-combined-offensive.title: Combined Offensive
class-marksman-combined-offensive.text: Perform this as two attacks in any order - one melee and one ranged. You may use your movement action in between them. You may freely holster weapons in between them.

class-warden.title: Warden
class-warden.text: The patrons’ voices grew ever louder, turning from cheers into a heated debate. Music soon stopped and only the drunken yells could be heard throughout the establishment. A menacing figure pushed through the crowd to stand before the instigator, measuring him up in silence. The instigator apologized, sat down, and the brawl was postponed to a later date. The novice desperately tried to hold off th

class-warden-iron-golem.title: Iron Golem
class-warden-iron-golem.text: Whenever one of your armour points are broken, you gain 3 TVG. Whenever you restore an armour point, you gain +1 DMG until your next turn.

class-warden-bodyguard.title: Bodyguard
class-warden-bodyguard.text: Triggers on an ally within your movement distance being targeted by an attack. You move next to the ally, exchange places with them and change the target of the attack to yourself if it is a melee attack. If it is a ranged attack, you instead move at any point between the attacker and the targeted ally and change the target of the attack to yourself. Restore 1 armour point.

class-warden-invite-punishment.title: Invite Punishment
class-warden-invite-punishment.text: Taunt up to two target enemies (CL 14 Willpower save). Restore 3 Strain for each enemy you successfully taunt this way.

class-warden-unburdened.title: Unburdened
class-warden-unburdened.text: You may choose to deplete all of your armour points at the start of your turn. If you do, gain a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of that turn.

class-warden-regain-composure.title: Regain Composure
class-warden-regain-composure.text: Regain 2 armour points if you have no armour points. Restore 7 Strain if you have more than half of your SL.

class-warden-locomotive.title: Locomotive
class-warden-locomotive.text: Perform an additional movement action. You may pass through enemies as you perform it and knock them and the attack’s target prone (CL 14 Stance save).

class-warden-gaze-and-tremble.title: Gaze and Tremble
class-warden-gaze-and-tremble.text: Whenever you Taunt or Intimidate an enemy, you may instead inflict the other of the effects. Instead of having a duration, those status effects last until the afflicted enemy successfully deals DMG to you. Deal +1 Stun and +1 Break against targets you have Taunted or Intimidated.

class-warden-tremendous-presence.title: Tremendous Presence
class-warden-tremendous-presence.text: Until your next turn, enemies you have Taunted or Intimidated suffer your choice of the following: ● -2 ACC ● -2 EVA ● -1 Tile of Movement Speed

class-duelist.title: Duelist
class-duelist.text: As the feast was nearing its end, she arose from her seat, an old flimsy rapier on her hip, and issued a challenge for the rank to her commanding officer. He snickered among his close associates, calling on his armored warden to duel in his stead. She engaged the iron golem in a mockery of a fencing match, making provocative yet harmless strikes at his iron shell. When the golem decided to end the

class-duelist-duel-etiquette.title: Duel Etiquette
class-duelist-duel-etiquette.text: After performing an attack that requires 2 or more AP, enter the Offensive Stance. After using a defensive action enter the Defensive Stance. Offensive Stance: You gain +1 DMG and your melee attacks inflict Pierce 1. Defensive Stance: You gain +1 EVA.

class-duelist-fleche.title: Fleche
class-duelist-fleche.text: This attack gains +3 ACC if you have moved towards your target this turn. Offensive Stance: Gain a free movement action. This attack deals +2 DMG.

class-duelist-anticipate.title: Anticipate
class-duelist-anticipate.text: Offensive Stance: During your next turn gain +2 ACC for each attack made against you from now until that turn. Defensive Stance: Heal 3 Strain for each attack made against you until your next turn.

class-duelist-rising-momentum.title: Rising Momentum
class-duelist-rising-momentum.text: Gain +1 DMG on each consecutive successful attack. When you are hit while this bonus is active, that attack gains the bonus instead and the bonus is reset.

class-duelist-lethal-tempo.title: Lethal Tempo
class-duelist-lethal-tempo.text: Whenever you deal DMG this round, heal an equal amount of Strain.

class-duelist-blade-waltz.title: Blade Waltz
class-duelist-blade-waltz.text: Offensive Stance: This attack may be repeated for any number of different enemies. Movement actions may be used in between these additional attacks.

class-duelist-rising-tension.title: Rising Tension
class-duelist-rising-tension.text: Gain an additional reaction every round while in Defensive Stance. Fleche has +1 DMG and inflicts Pierce 2 in the Defensive Stance.

class-duelist-backup-plan.title: Backup Plan
class-duelist-backup-plan.text: This attack doesn’t suffer penalties for being performed at A range. Only usable with a 1H ranged weapon. Enter any Stance or remove your current Stance.

class-duelist-coup.title: Coup
class-duelist-coup.text: Disarm an adjacent target (CL 18 Stance Save).

class-gunslinger.title: Gunslinger
class-gunslinger.text: He could not save his mother from the marauders. He spent hours wandering the wasteland, aimlessly looking for his final resting place. He finally sat down on the dusty, dry ground in the shade of some tall rocks, his look gazing at his final sunset. He must have sat there for over an hour, shifting his look from the sun to his father’s pistol. It did not save his mother, but it did save him, and

class-gunslinger-showdown.title: Showdown
class-gunslinger-showdown.text: You gain 1 Empowered Shot Charge whenever you perform a ranged attack. Upon reaching the maximum of 3 Charges, you may spend them while performing any pistol ranged attack in order to empower it: Zenith: This attack gains Pierce 3 and +3 DMG. Nadir: This attack heals 4 SN and gains +2 ACC.

class-gunslinger-quickdraw.title: Quickdraw
class-gunslinger-quickdraw.text: Triggers upon entering combat. This attack is only usable against targets who have not yet acted.

class-gunslinger-lightning-hands.title: Lightning Hands
class-gunslinger-lightning-hands.text: Gains +2 DMG when used against a target who hasn’t had a turn during this combat round.

class-gunslinger-morning-sun.title: Morning Sun
class-gunslinger-morning-sun.text: Holstering Pistol and Rifles is a free action. Your Pistol and Rifles gain +1 DMG per attack you perform with either of them in a turn until the end of that turn. Showdown gains the following option at 3 Charges: Mayhem: Gain 3 AP and suffer 4 Strain. You may use abilities again this turn.

class-gunslinger-faceoff.title: Faceoff
class-gunslinger-faceoff.text: You may target any number of additional targets with this attack and it costs 2 additional Strain per target beyond the first.

class-gunslinger-wasteful-barrage.title: Wasteful Barrage
class-gunslinger-wasteful-barrage.text: Empty your weapon’s entire magazine into a target in cover. The target and other creatures within its A suffer 1 DMG per ammo you depleted this way.

class-gunslinger-evening-breeze.title: Evening Breeze
class-gunslinger-evening-breeze.text: While you are in Stealth, restore 2 VG while at less than half of your max VG and reduce the level of all damaging status effects by 1 at the end of your turn. Showdown gains the following option at 3 Charges: Fade: Enter Stealth if you end your turn in cover and out of direct line of sight of your enemies.

class-gunslinger-masterful-shot.title: Masterful Shot
class-gunslinger-masterful-shot.text: You may activate any Empowered Shot effect without spending charges when you perform this ability. Gain +2 EVA until your next turn.

class-gunslinger-pain-tolerance.title: Pain Tolerance
class-gunslinger-pain-tolerance.text: Triggers on you being damaged by an enemy. Gain a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of your next turn.

class-rogue.title: Rogue
class-rogue.text: When her mother disappeared she tried her best to make it work. She offered herself for all sorts of work, yet most would reject her for her nearly skeletal appearance. How was she to feed her baby brother without money? A loaf of bread stolen here, some jewelry snatched in a busy street there – sometimes she felt like she could really make it work. Other times they’d go a week without food, becom

class-rogue-veil-of-shadows.title: Veil of Shadows
class-rogue-veil-of-shadows.text: Gain advantage on rolls being performed in Stealth while near creatures who would be hostile to this action. You may enter Stealth whenever you use a defensive action while in full cover and out of enemies’ lines of sight. While in Stealth, the cost of abilities you perform is reduced by 2 Strain.

class-rogue-wicked-glint.title: Wicked Glint
class-rogue-wicked-glint.text: This attack suffers no penalties for being performed at A range. If you have a free hand, you may use holstered weapons to perform this attack.

class-rogue-swift-resupply.title: Swift Resupply
class-rogue-swift-resupply.text: When performing this ability in cover, choose two of the following: ● Restore 1 VG ● Restore 1 SN ● Freely holster and equip weapons ● Gain +1 EVA until your next turn ● Use or apply a consumable to your equipment

class-rogue-stacked-sleeve.title: Stacked Sleeve
class-rogue-stacked-sleeve.text: You may use Pistol and consumables with Wicked Glint. Whenever you perform a defensive action, you may reload any equipped weapon by paying 1 Strain.

class-rogue-explosive-deterrent.title: Explosive Deterrent
class-rogue-explosive-deterrent.text: Use an explosive consumable and gain a free movement action.

class-rogue-last-drop.title: Last Drop
class-rogue-last-drop.text: Only usable against targets who have 2 or less VG.

class-rogue-flawless-misdirection.title: Flawless Misdirection
class-rogue-flawless-misdirection.text: You may enter Stealth via the effects of Veil of Shadows while in ¾ cover. Wicked glint may be performed with no bonus DMG from ACC overflow without breaking Stealth.

class-rogue-shocking-display.title: Shocking Display
class-rogue-shocking-display.text: Your next attack while in Stealth inflicts Stun 2 on up to two targets within your target’s M. This effect lasts until your next turn.

class-rogue-silent-elimination.title: Silent Elimination
class-rogue-silent-elimination.text: This attack gains +8 DMG against Unaware targets. If it kills the target while you are in Stealth, you remain in Stealth. Usable only with quiet weapons.

class-stalker.title: Stalker
class-stalker.text: The trees surrounding his perimeter all had malicious, highly toxic lichens growing on their bark. The paths leading to his shack had multiple concealed pits with falls landing onto carefully placed rusty, metal spikes. Various zones of his territory had an intricate tripwire system that would alert him if any kind of intruder dared to enter. He would spend the long nights maintaining this web of

class-stalker-unfair-advantage.title: Unfair Advantage
class-stalker-unfair-advantage.text: Whenever an enemy triggers one of your traps or hazards, choose one of the following: ● Heal 3 Strain. ● Gain a reaction. ● Gain +2 ACC against that enemy until the end of your next turn.

class-stalker-opportune-strike.title: Opportune Strike
class-stalker-opportune-strike.text: Triggers upon enemy triggering a trap or hazard. Gains +2 DMG if triggered by a trap.

class-stalker-vicious-design.title: Vicious Design
class-stalker-vicious-design.text: Unfair Advantage gains the following option when triggered by a trap: ● The enemy suffers Bleeding 2. ● The enemy suffers Feeble 3

class-stalker-reset-mechanism.title: Reset Mechanism
class-stalker-reset-mechanism.text: Rearm a trap you have set up or set up a trap within your A.

class-stalker-merciful-end.title: Merciful End
class-stalker-merciful-end.text: Triggers on an enemy reaching half or less of their maximum HP upon triggering your trap.

class-stalker-cruel-domain.title: Cruel Domain
class-stalker-cruel-domain.text: Successful attacks you perform on enemies standing within your hazards inflict Fractured equal to the amount of AP you spent on the attack.

class-stalker-better-view.title: Better View
class-stalker-better-view.text: Triggers on an enemy triggering your hazard. Gain and use a movement action.

class-bard.title: Bard
class-bard.text: He stood upon the stage, the festival crowd below him, humming along to his melody. They did not know it, but this night would stay with them forever. After a brief pause, he inserted an ambedic crystal into his modified violin, a shard containing the happiest of memories he had shared with his late wife. Though he played a familiar love song, his reproduction gave it a surreal texture as the shar

class-bard-transmitter.title: Transmitter
class-bard-transmitter.text: A specialized ambedic device connected to your instrument allows you to play it even while it is not equipped. Channeled abilities using your instruments only cost you up to 1 AP total to upkeep per turn.

class-bard-theme-variation.title: Theme Variation
class-bard-theme-variation.text: If you are already performing a channeled ability with your instrument, immediately perform another one and continue to channel both of them without paying an AP cost. You may only channel up to two abilities at once using this ability.

class-bard-trance.title: Trance
class-bard-trance.text: Heal 2 Strain for each channeled instrument ability you are currently performing.

class-bard-inspiring-reproduction.title: Inspiring Reproduction
class-bard-inspiring-reproduction.text: While channeling 2 or more instrument abilities, allies within their range all gain your choice of the following on each of your turns: ● +2 EVA ● Heal 2 Strain ● Gain 2 THP (unstackable)

class-bard-appoint-champion.title: Appoint Champion
class-bard-appoint-champion.text: Triple the effects of your channeled abilities from instruments that affect a target ally until your next turn (does not stack with other multiplicative effects). That ally also gains 1 temporary destiny point that lasts until your next turn.

class-bard-derail-retelling.title: Derail Retelling
class-bard-derail-retelling.text: Triggers on you or an ally being hit by an attack by 4 or more points above EVA. The character that triggered this ability gains +8 EVA until your next turn and gains 1 temporary destiny point until the end of your next turn.

class-bard-revolting-reproduction.title: Revolting Reproduction
class-bard-revolting-reproduction.text: While channeling 2 or more instrument abilities, enemies within their range all suffer your choice of the following on each of your turns: ● Bleeding 1 (unstackable) ● Burn 1 (unstackable) ● -1 EVA

class-bard-visceral-performance.title: Visceral Performance
class-bard-visceral-performance.text: Triple the effects of your channeled abilities from instruments that affect enemies until your next turn (does not stack with other multiplicative effects).

class-bard-farewell-theme.title: Farewell Theme
class-bard-farewell-theme.text: Use a weapon to reduce yourself to 0 HP and become incapacitated. This attack targets and inflicts DMG on all enemies within your channeled abilities’ ranges equal to their combined Strain cost. Your channeled abilities remain channeled for 2 more turns after this ability is performed, and their effects double on each of those turns. You may suffer a failing instead of an injury for performing this attack.

class-envoy.title: Envoy
class-envoy.text: As he was being transported to the scene they briefed him on the situation, on the trapped family and the maniac who was about to burn down the building they were in. Before entering his assistant passed him a tiny pistol which he tucked away in his pocket. Entering the building, he could see naught but dim, dusty hallways and narrow passages. He pleaded with the beast for nearly an hour before fi

class-envoy-tactical-engine.title: Tactical Engine
class-envoy-tactical-engine.text: You may use any order ability for only 1 AP. If you do, you may not use additional order abilities that turn and you suffer 1 Strain for each order target who fails to complete the order.

class-envoy-grand-plan.title: Grand Plan
class-envoy-grand-plan.text: Perform any order ability at no AP cost and choose up to 5 targets for it. During your next turn, you may perform another order ability at no AP cost targeting those same targets. You suffer 1 Strain for each target who fails to complete the order and heal 8 Strain if all targets complete both orders.

class-envoy-fallback-option.title: Fallback Option
class-envoy-fallback-option.text: This ability costs 3 Strain less if an ally failed to complete one of your orders since your previous turn.

class-envoy-centerpiece.title: Centerpiece
class-envoy-centerpiece.text: You may freely target yourself with orders you perform in addition to their regular targets. You cannot suffer SN for not completing your own order and the first order you assign to yourself while using Grand Plan is always counted as completed. For each ally who completes an order after you have done so, both you and that ally restore 1 Strain.

class-envoy-moment-of-celebration.title: Moment of Celebration
class-envoy-moment-of-celebration.text: Usable only if all targets of your order and you have completed that order since your previous turn. Restore 4 Strain and gain 1 temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of combat.

class-envoy-determined-execution.title: Determined Execution
class-envoy-determined-execution.text: Triggers on your ability that would complete your order failing. You may reroll that ability.

class-envoy-mastermind.title: Mastermind
class-envoy-mastermind.text: Whenever all targets of an order complete it, restore 2 SN and gain a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of the encounter. You may spend destiny points to give AP to the targets of your orders with a limit of 1 AP per target per combat round.

class-envoy-field-promotion.title: Field Promotion
class-envoy-field-promotion.text: Grant a willing ally 3 AP. They may use the same abilities twice during their turn and they suffer 4 SN.

class-envoy-disciplinary-action.title: Disciplinary Action
class-envoy-disciplinary-action.text: Triggers on an allies’ ability that would complete your order failing. They may increase their roll by 1 per 2 SN they spend.

class-wayfarer.title: Wayfarer
class-wayfarer.text: He ran through the grassy field, both arrows and snow raining down on him. Left, right, left right - the arrows swooped by him, yet none would hit their mark. No matter the conditions, he would deliver the message today, and neither a force of man nor nature would interrupt him. This unending source of resolve was inspired by neither love nor sentimentality, but was a product of a life that knew n

class-wayfarer-experienced-guide.title: Experienced Guide
class-wayfarer-experienced-guide.text: Whenever your ally rolls an Endurance, Perception or Survival check, you may also roll it and add +2 to their roll if you succeed. Allies moving towards you gain +1 tile of Movement speed.

class-wayfarer-target-call.title: Target Call
class-wayfarer-target-call.text: Target creature is Marked. Abilities performed by you and your allies targeting the marked creature gain +2 DMG and cost 2 Strain less. The mark disappears the next time you use this ability.

class-wayfarer-point-out.title: Point Out
class-wayfarer-point-out.text: Give yourself or an ally within your M +4 EVA until your next turn. You heal 4 Strain for each attack that misses them or you during this period.

class-wayfarer-defiant-example.title: Defiant Example
class-wayfarer-defiant-example.text: Whenever you suffer DMG, choose an ally to gain that much TVG. Interacting with an ally is now a free action.

class-wayfarer-savior.title: Savior
class-wayfarer-savior.text: Triggers on ally getting damaged. If you can reach them with one movement action, you may move to them or you may gain +3 ACC on attacks targeting the creature that damaged them until the end of your next turn.

class-wayfarer-vigil.title: Vigil
class-wayfarer-vigil.text: You and your allies within your M gain +1 Tile of movement speed until your next turn. If any of them would perform a death save, you may spend 6 Strain in order for it to automatically succeed.

class-wayfarer-hard-target.title: Hard Target
class-wayfarer-hard-target.text: Whenever you move twice in a turn, gain +2 EVA until your next turn. You gain +4 Burden capacity.

class-wayfarer-rapid-traversal.title: Rapid Traversal
class-wayfarer-rapid-traversal.text: Gain an additional Movement action. The next time you move this turn, gain +2 ACC and +2 DMG on your next attack if standing next to an enemy or +3 EVA if no enemies are within your A.

class-wayfarer-proximity-response.title: Proximity Response
class-wayfarer-proximity-response.text: Triggers on entering or leaving of A of an enemy. Inflict Stun 2. The target cannot move until the end of their next turn (CL 16 Stance Save).

class-apothecary.title: Apothecary
class-apothecary.text: An old woman sat in a dimly lit room behind a desk laid with flasks and bottles. She ground some herbs in a mortar before finally mixing them into a thick, greenish liquid that has been placed over a light flame for hours. She would later use it to create an intense incense to ward off the creatures of the night. She would sometimes catch herself dreaming of the world beyond the forest, of what sh

class-apothecary-alchemist-s-bag.title: Alchemist’s Bag
class-apothecary-alchemist-s-bag.text: You have access to a personal pouch of concoctions that don’t require ingredients to be prepared as long as you’re not trapped somewhere. Once per week, you may prepare 3 simple concoctions and 1 advanced concoction for that pouch. New concoctions take up the slots of existing ones.

class-apothecary-incision.title: Incision
class-apothecary-incision.text: Choose one: Harm: Perform an attack with +2 ACC that inflicts Bleeding 1. Any poisons applied to your weapon deal +2 DMG this attack. Heal: Perform a Defensive action and a CL 14 Survival check on yourself or an adjacent ally to reduce the target’s Bleeding by 2. If at half or less of their maximum VG, they restore 3 VG.

class-apothecary-theorem-application.title: Theorem Application
class-apothecary-theorem-application.text: Consume or apply a concoction to yourself or an ally. If you are at half or more of your SL, heal 5 SN.

class-apothecary-durable-fangs.title: Durable Fangs
class-apothecary-durable-fangs.text: Alchemist’s Bag gains a new slot for an advanced poison. Attacks you perform that exceed the target’s EVA score by 2 or more do not consume your weapon’s applied poison.

class-apothecary-subject-observation.title: Subject Observation
class-apothecary-subject-observation.text: Gain +3 EVA against enemies who have been affected by your concoctions this turn until your next turn.

class-apothecary-lethal-dose.title: Lethal Dose
class-apothecary-lethal-dose.text: The target of your next attack with a poisoned weapon suffers the effects of that poison again on their next turn.

class-apothecary-battlefield-medic.title: Battlefield Medic
class-apothecary-battlefield-medic.text: Alchemist’s Bag gains a new slot for an elixir. Utility actions that interact with allies are performed at Instant speed.

class-apothecary-better-than-new.title: Better Than New
class-apothecary-better-than-new.text: The next time you would apply a concoction to an ally or successfully perform a survival check on them this turn they gain +2 ACC on their next attack and heal 2 VG and 2 SN.

class-apothecary-overdose.title: Overdose
class-apothecary-overdose.text: Apply two doses of one or more concoctions to yourself or an ally.

class-clairvoyant.title: Clairvoyant
class-clairvoyant.text: The crime scene was already blocked off and detectives were swarming the premises - they were waiting for her. As she entered the dim tent, her eyes briefly scanned the room before settling on the dead body in the middle. She calmed her breathing and focused on her engraved ring, on the corpse. She felt the scene of death assemble before her and play out the exact moment the deceased cried out in

class-clairvoyant-analytical-mind.title: Analytical Mind
class-clairvoyant-analytical-mind.text: Whenever you Analyze a target, gain a choice of either +2 ACC or +2 EVA against them. The target stops being Analyzed when you Analyze a new target.

class-clairvoyant-memory-extraction.title: Memory Extraction
class-clairvoyant-memory-extraction.text: This attack inflicts Stun and SN equal to the DMG it would deal and heals an equal amount of your SN. Must target an Analyzed target.

class-clairvoyant-overlord.title: /> Overlord
class-clairvoyant-overlord.text: Grant your buffs against Analyzed targets to any number of allies.

class-clairvoyant-psyche-fracture.title: Psyche Fracture
class-clairvoyant-psyche-fracture.text: Your Eidoloscope attacks now deal DMG in addition to their other effects and you inflict Fractured 1 on successful Eidoloscope attacks against Analyzed targets and .

class-clairvoyant-known-weakness.title: Known Weakness
class-clairvoyant-known-weakness.text: Gain the unchosen buff from Mind Glimpse in addition to the one you chose.

class-clairvoyant-neural-shutdown.title: Neural Shutdown
class-clairvoyant-neural-shutdown.text: Incapacitate a target (CL 16 Willpower Save). If the target resists the incapacitation, you take the DMG of the attack instead.

class-clairvoyant-past-unraveled.title: Past Unraveled
class-clairvoyant-past-unraveled.text: Analyzing a new target doesn’t remove the condition from your previous target.

class-clairvoyant-predetermined-outcome.title: Predetermined Outcome
class-clairvoyant-predetermined-outcome.text: Until your next turn, each roll against Analyzed targets performed by you or your allies restores you 1 SN. Only usable while at half or more of your SL.

class-clairvoyant-safeguard-protocol.title: Safeguard Protocol
class-clairvoyant-safeguard-protocol.text: Lose any amount of HP. Your allies gain that much EVA until your next turn.

class-mechanist.title: Mechanist
class-mechanist.text: It finally moved! She had been working on the little automaton for months, and she finally managed to get it to move. She was starting to get frustrated, not knowing whether it was the design of the motor and the legs or her ambedic link to the little machine that was at fault. For someone who was proud to exclaim that she would never mother a child, she sure seemed excited to witness her creation

class-mechanist-sensory-meld.title: Sensory Meld
class-mechanist-sensory-meld.text: You may suffer VG damage instead of Strain for performing Echo, Construct and Mechanist Class abilities.

class-mechanist-overclock.title: Overclock
class-mechanist-overclock.text: A construct you are paired with gains +2 ACC, +1 DMG dealt and +1 Tile of movement until your next turn. Make a CL 14 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

class-mechanist-breaking-point.title: Breaking Point
class-mechanist-breaking-point.text: Triggers upon construct having 0 or less HP or otherwise shutting down. Prevent the construct from shutting down until your next turn.

class-mechanist-mind-fragmentation.title: Mind Fragmentation
class-mechanist-mind-fragmentation.text: You can be paired with two Constructs at the same time and you can perform two command abilities or perform the same command ability twice in a single turn provided they target two different Constructs. At the beginning of your turn you may lose your Movement action to gain 1 AP that can only be spent on command abilities targeting constructs.

class-mechanist-target-triangulation.title: Target Triangulation
class-mechanist-target-triangulation.text: This attack gains +3 ACC for each of your paired constructs within C of the target. After performing this ability, your allies gain the same ACC bonuses against that target until your next turn or until the constructs are no longer in the correct range.

class-mechanist-bodily-extension.title: Bodily Extension
class-mechanist-bodily-extension.text: Triggers on an enemy attack hitting you or an ally. If it was a melee attack, any construct you are paired with within your or your ally’s M may come to the target’s aid to a tile adjacent to them and redirect the attack to itself. If it was a ranged attack, any construct you are paired with within M of that attack’s trajectory may move into it and redirect the attack to itself.

class-mechanist-load-dampening.title: Load Dampening
class-mechanist-load-dampening.text: The cost of regaining AP while piloting a mech costs you only 2 Strain per AP. You may regain the 4th AP in a turn that costs 4 Strain and requires a CL 18 Engineering check. On a failure, the Mech suffers a Glitch.

class-mechanist-subsystem-optimization.title: Subsystem Optimization
class-mechanist-subsystem-optimization.text: Triggers on the start of your turn while you are piloting a Mech. You may eliminate the cooldown of your Mech’s subsystem. Make a CL 18 Engineering check. On a failure, the Mech suffers a Glitch.

class-mechanist-ambedic-pulse.title: Ambedic Pulse
class-mechanist-ambedic-pulse.text: Disturb your mech’s power source, inflicting SN equal to your own SN to all creatures within M of the Mech. This attack cannot miss and cannot deal overflowing DMG. You are ejected from the Mech.

class-arbiter.title: Arbiter
class-arbiter.text: A man sits under the cloudy, silvery sky, his body still yet his eyes twitching wildly. In his thoughts, he is far above the valley, soaring through the cold heavens above. His wings click and shift, producing crisp, metallic sounds. He knows the storm is coming, so he flies southward to warn his kin. Landing on a predetermined signal pad, his fellow takes note, and the man disassociates from the

class-arbiter-eye-of-the-murder.title: Eye of the Murder
class-arbiter-eye-of-the-murder.text: At the beginning of your turn, you call a crow construct to your vicinity. Whenever you perform an attack, you may send out two crows to: Fracture: Inflict Fractured 1 on the target. Crows leave your vicinity upon being used by this ability.

class-arbiter-unseen-aid.title: Unseen Aid
class-arbiter-unseen-aid.text: Conviction: Trumst Call a nearby crow construct to your vicinity (that stays) to perform your choice of the following: Assist: Gain 1 AP that persists between rounds and does not count towards your default cap of 3 AP. Pinpoint: Move your MO. Shelter: Prevent the next instance of DMG you would receive and suffer twice as much SN instead.

class-arbiter-forcefield.title: Forcefield
class-arbiter-forcefield.text: Conviction: Trumst Inflict Push 1 on all enemies standing in your A and all enemies who enter your A until the next turn and heal 1 Strain per inflicted Push. Enemies may only be affected by the second condition of this ability once per turn.

class-arbiter-subjugating-presence.title: Subjugating Presence
class-arbiter-subjugating-presence.text: Status effects you inflict upon Intimidated enemies are increased by +1. Eye of The Murder gains the following option: Terrorize: inflict Intimidated which lasts until the target successfully attacks you instead of its usual duration.

class-arbiter-retribution.title: Retribution
class-arbiter-retribution.text: Conviction: Trumst If the target attacked during their previous turn, inflict Feeble 2. If the target used a defensive ability during their previous turn, inflict Bleeding 2. If the target used a utility ability, inflict Stun 2.

class-arbiter-grand-authority.title: Grand Authority
class-arbiter-grand-authority.text: Conviction: Trumst Gain 2 AP. You may spend destiny points to pay for this ability’s Strain cost.

class-arbiter-planar-attunement.title: Planar Attunement
class-arbiter-planar-attunement.text: You may dismiss crows to pay for 2 SN per crow when performing abilities. Eye of The Murder gains the following option: Omen: Arrange the crows in a pattern above the target, inflicting Immobilize 1 and Stun 1.

class-arbiter-anomalous-findings.title: Anomalous Findings
class-arbiter-anomalous-findings.text: Conviction: Trumst Triggers on an enemy performing an ability that costs 4+ Strain. Summon a crow construct to your vicinity.

class-arbiter-featherstorm.title: Featherstorm
class-arbiter-featherstorm.text: Conviction: Trumst Perform this attack on a number of targets equal to the number of crows in your vicinity each turn. Casting and upkeeping this ability costs 1 Destiny Point. If this cost is not paid, you suffer 3 Failing levels or 20 DMG instead.

class-empath.title: Empath
class-empath.text: After a battle would end, she would arrive. To tend to the survivors’ wounds, but more importantly to their souls. No matter the side, no matter the goal, no matter the thanks, she would comfort each and every living and dying soul, easing their mental toll and letting them return to their regular lives. She would take in all of this pain and dissolve it within herself, becoming a tiny bit more ho

class-empath-laid-bare.title: Laid Bare
class-empath-laid-bare.text: At the beginning of your turn in combat you may choose a creature with PSY equal to or lower than yours. You learn the actions that will be performed by the chosen creature during their next turn.

class-empath-vast-soul.title: Vast Soul
class-empath-vast-soul.text: Conviction: Bruma Heal SN equal to your class rank plus your highest Bruma conviction rank. An ally you can see gains +EVA equal to your class rank. Only usable at half or more of your maximum SL.

class-empath-ephemera.title: Ephemera
class-empath-ephemera.text: Conviction: Bruma Triggers on enemy performing an action in combat that requires a roll. You may reduce the roll by 2.

class-empath-fate-foretold.title: Fate Foretold
class-empath-fate-foretold.text: Once per day, you may roll 3d6 and note down the result. During that day, you may replace any roll you witness with the noted result.

class-empath-predetermination.title: Predetermination
class-empath-predetermination.text: Conviction: Bruma If one exists, give the target of an ability predicted through Laid Bare +2 EVA against that attack.

class-empath-fate-rejected.title: Fate Rejected
class-empath-fate-rejected.text: Conviction: Bruma Activate after any roll. Increase a failing by 2 ranks or gain a new failing at rank 2. You gain a number of temporary destiny points equal to your DP maximum that can be spent in any way on that roll. Those destiny points disappear after the roll.

class-empath-void-brand.title: Void Brand
class-empath-void-brand.text: Whenever you inflict SN upon a creature, that creature becomes Branded until the end of combat or for 2 hours outside of combat. You gain +2 on all PSY and Bruma ability rolls against Branded creatures.

class-empath-self-implosion.title: Self Implosion
class-empath-self-implosion.text: Conviction: Bruma The target’s non-defensive abilities cost +2 SN until your next turn (CL 15 Willpower Save). While this effect persists, the target suffers DMG equal to the SN it inflicts upon itself via ability usage.

class-empath-annul.title: Annul
class-empath-annul.text: Conviction: Bruma Target creature suffers DMG equal to their current SN (CL 15 Willpower save).

class-sorcerer.title: Sorcerer
class-sorcerer.text: His parents woke him and his sister up in the middle of the night in a panicked hurry. They barely had time to dress before they were dragged out of their house and into the dark woods, alone. As they ran they could hear screams behind them and see a pyre where their home once stood. After hours of travel they collapsed in a secluded den, holding hands as they shook from the cold. He berated himse

class-sorcerer-beacon-of-sacrifice.title: Beacon of Sacrifice
class-sorcerer-beacon-of-sacrifice.text: You may suffer SN instead of VG damage inflicted by Soulburn. Reaching Soulburn 5 grants you a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of the encounter, once per combat encounter.

class-sorcerer-engine-of-consumption.title: Engine of Consumption
class-sorcerer-engine-of-consumption.text: Conviction: Vamor You do not suffer Soulburn DMG during your next turn. Choose any option an amount of times equal to your Soulburn rank: Spark: Inflict Burn 1 on a target within your C. Soothe: Heal 1 SN to a target ally within your C.

class-sorcerer-flaming-rebirth.title: Flaming Rebirth
class-sorcerer-flaming-rebirth.text: Conviction: Vamor Restore 8 SN as long as your SN is at half or above your SL max. You suffer Fractured 1 until the end of your next turn and Feeble 2 until the end of the turn following that one.

class-sorcerer-blazing-artillery.title: Blazing Artillery
class-sorcerer-blazing-artillery.text: Engine of Consumption costs you only 1 AP to perform and its Spark option has a range of M and it no longer freezes the Soulburn DMG during your next turn. Witnessing an enemy be incapacitated by a Vamor ability or Burn restores 2 VG and 2 SN to you.

class-sorcerer-ignition.title: Ignition
class-sorcerer-ignition.text: Conviction: Vamor Spend any amount of SN to suffer that much Soulburn. If you spend SN this way, gain +2 EVA until your next turn.

class-sorcerer-wildfire.title: Wildfire
class-sorcerer-wildfire.text: Conviction: Vamor Take another turn after this one. Usable only if your Soulburn is at rank 6 or higher. Costs 1 Destiny Point per use beyond the first in a combat encounter.

class-sorcerer-example-eternal.title: Example Eternal
class-sorcerer-example-eternal.text: Engine of Consumption’s Soothe option has a range of M. Vamor Mysticism abilities you perform that target only you may be used on up to 3 total targets within your M whenever you perform them. Whenever you witness an ally under the influence of your Vamor Mysticism abilities incapacitate an enemy, restore 2 VG and 2 SN.

class-sorcerer-heat-redistribution.title: Heat Redistribution
class-sorcerer-heat-redistribution.text: Conviction: Vamor Heal an amount of VG equal to your Soulburn rank distributed amongst any number of allies within your C. You may spend a Destiny Point while performing this ability to extend the range to M and double the VG available. ●

class-sorcerer-inner-persistance.title: Inner Persistance
class-sorcerer-inner-persistance.text: Conviction: Vamor Triggers on you suffering DMG. Instead of taking that DMG, suffer that much Soulburn instead.

class-witch.title: Witch
class-witch.text: She burst into the dimly lit cellar with only a purple flower in hand. On a central table there was a beggar, his leg amputated in order to evoke more pity from the passersby. Around him, two grotesque figures stood, instruments of pain in hand and grimaces in place of what would be their faces. She took a whiff of the flower and attuned to the torturer’s bodies, analysing their bones and muscles.

class-witch-rhythm-of-life.title: Rhythm of Life
class-witch-rhythm-of-life.text: When performing a Survival or Medicine check on a creature, you may gain Strain to increase your result by that much up to a maximum of +2. Halice abilities that require Attunement can be performed without it and apply it to their targets after being performed.

class-witch-fleshbound-hex.title: Fleshbound Hex
class-witch-fleshbound-hex.text: Target up to 3 targets within your Attunement network, remove them from the network and inflict one of the following upon them: Flay Skin: Inflict Bleeding 2. Grind Bones: Inflict Stun 2. The target cannot move until the end of their next turn (CL 18 Stance save). Spoil Humors: Inflict Feeble 2. The target suffers +1 DMG from all sources until the end of your next turn.

class-witch-emergency-binding.title: Emergency Binding
class-witch-emergency-binding.text: Conviction: Halice Target yourself or an ally. The target restores VG equal to the VG they lost since their previous turn +1. Each consecutive use of this ability also inflicts Bleeding equal to the number of times the ability has been used.

class-witch-flesh-ward.title: Flesh Ward
class-witch-flesh-ward.text: Allies within your Attunement network gain 2 TVG whenever you perform Fleshbound Hex. You may perform Vital attunement at only 1 AP cost by suffering 3 SN.

class-witch-flaying-snare.title: Flaying Snare
class-witch-flaying-snare.text: Triggers on an ally within your Attunement network being damaged. The attacker is added to your Attunement network and they suffer Bleeding 2.

class-witch-sensory-overload.title: Sensory Overload
class-witch-sensory-overload.text: Target up to 8 creatures. They are considered a part of your Attunement network until the end of your turn.

class-witch-repurposed-servants.title: Repurposed Servants
class-witch-repurposed-servants.text: You may control up to two Zombies at the same time. Zombies you control do not suffer ACC penalties from being reanimated.

class-witch-splinter-spider.title: Splinter Spider
class-witch-splinter-spider.text: Target a Zombie you control that’s next to an enemy target and has full AP. The Zombie latches onto the target (CL 16 Stance Save) and, if the target fails to resist them, uses their ribcage and other available bones as a makeshift bear trap, performing a +0 ACC 4 DMG attack that cannot miss and inflicts Bleeding 3.

class-witch-sack-rapture.title: Sack Rapture
class-witch-sack-rapture.text: Must target a corpse. This attack affects the C range of the corpse. The corpse explodes, inflicting Push 1, Fractured 2 and Stun 2 on those caught within the blast.

class-protean.title: Protean
class-protean.text: With his sister’s death he was left truly and utterly alone. His days blended together into a single foggy timeline as he aimlessly wandered the city’s streets. Nobody was left to give him tasks, nobody was left to scold him, nobody was left to hold him while he slept on the cold cobblestone. In this dreamy state he would often imagine himself a stray cat, jumping about the various windows and pol

class-protean-dissociative-self.title: Dissociative Self
class-protean-dissociative-self.text: You forgo the destiny point cost of the Beast discipline abilities. You may not raise a Conviction to a rank beyond 1 and you may not spend destiny points to add Conviction bonuses to rolls. If you reach a point where you have 3 Failings at rank 4, you will completely destabilize, get lost within your own unreality and disappear. If you reach a point where you have no more Failings, you will be cured of this condition. In addition to other costs, in order to reduce a Failing to rank 0 you must also spend 7 XP or reduce your skills to make up for the cost. When you get rid of your condition, your memories and body revert to the state they were in before you were afflicted. Your life as a protean remains in your mind as nothing but a painful, long and hazy daydream.

class-protean-selfscape.title: Selfscape
class-protean-selfscape.text: Spend 1 Destiny Point to perform this ability or increase one of your Failings by 1 rank. Gain 3 AP and an additional reaction until your next turn. The AP gained this way may only be spent on Beast and Protean abilities.

class-protean-manifest-delusion.title: Manifest Delusion
class-protean-manifest-delusion.text: If you are not damaged until your next turn, heal 8 SN down to half of your max SL. Otherwise, gain 3 temporary destiny points that last until the end of the combat encounter and increase one of your Failings by 1 rank.

class-protean-entropic-being.title: Entropic Being
class-protean-entropic-being.text: Abilities your perform cost 1 Strain less. Manifest Flesh and Manifest Matter last until the end of the combat encounter. You lose one of the body parts or items gained from them every time you suffer 3 or more DMG in a single attack.

class-protean-imagined-flesh.title: Imagined Flesh
class-protean-imagined-flesh.text: Triggers on enemy attack dealing 3 or more DMG to you. Choose: Sacrifice: Destroy one of your manifested body parts to completely negate the DMG of the attack. Retaliate: Perform an immediate +2 ACC +0 DMG attack that inflicts Fractured 1 on the enemy who triggered this reaction.

class-protean-lifeline.title: Lifeline
class-protean-lifeline.text: Costs a number of destiny points equal to your DP maximum to perform. Destroy all of your manifested body parts and items and heal 2 VG and 2 SN for each of them. Reduce one of your Failings by 1 rank.

class-protean-surrogate-identity.title: Surrogate Identity
class-protean-surrogate-identity.text: When performing any kind of social roll, you may suffer up to 3 SN to gain an equal bonus for that roll. Manifest Flesh may be cast using 1 Destiny Point in order to completely change your appearance to match that of a known creature instead of its other effects.

class-protean-miserable-puppet.title: Miserable Puppet
class-protean-miserable-puppet.text: The creature you are taking the appearance of that is witnessing you suffers Strain whenever you suffer strain or DMG until your next turn.

class-protean-cling-to-reality.title: Cling to Reality
class-protean-cling-to-reality.text: Costs a number of destiny points equal to your DP maximum to perform. Abandon your disguise and lose the ability to change your appearance for 4 weeks. Reduce one of your Failings by 2 ranks.

class-vessel.title: Vessel
class-vessel.text: Her appetite wasn’t the same ever since the incident in the forest. In the span of a single day she had developed insomnia, her skin had begun to shed in places, and she couldn’t stand the smell of the blooming lilies. That first night she had been turning in her bed for hours, unable to even close her eyes. The pulsating tumor in her back writhed in pain, worming around her spine. It slithered up

class-vessel-vampiric-parasite.title: Vampiric Parasite
class-vessel-vampiric-parasite.text: The Vessel exists in a constant state of struggle against its patron and intruder, suffering a permanent Conviction as long as they have this condition: Hunger: I will feast on the blood of the recently deceased. This Conviction must be fulfilled within a week of suffering a Crisis or it will trigger another Crisis. Fulfilling it grants the Vessel 1 Destiny Point and increases the rank of Hunger. Ingesting herbal poisons lowers the rank of Hunger by 1 rank but inflicts a -20% maximum VG and SN penalty, rounded up, for two weeks. If Hunger would increase beyond the maximum rank, the Vessel is fully overtaken by the parasite and it fully consumes their body. A surgery may be performed once Hunger is at rank 0 to remove the parasite (CL 22 Medicine). The Vessel heals VG equal to their class rank on all hemomancy attacks that inflict Bleeding.

class-vessel-crimson-rain.title: Crimson Rain
class-vessel-crimson-rain.text: This attack may target up to 3 targets who are already bleeding. Inflict Bleeding 2.

class-vessel-sate-hunger.title: Sate Hunger
class-vessel-sate-hunger.text: Must target a corpse, a willing or an unaware creature and may only be used once per target. Restore 5 VG and 5 SN and deal 10 DMG to the target if it’s a living creature.

class-vessel-unquenchable-thirst.title: Unquenchable Thirst
class-vessel-unquenchable-thirst.text: Hunger extends to overtake another of your Conviction slots and is treated as having 8 ranks. Ingesting herbal poisons now inflicts a -50% maximum VG and SN penalty, rounded up, for one week. While at less than half of your maximum VG, your hemomancy attacks deal +1 DMG and inflict Bleeding 1.

class-vessel-violent-urge.title: Violent Urge
class-vessel-violent-urge.text: Lose half of your maximum VG, rounded up. Your next hemomancy attack inflicts Bleeding 2.

class-vessel-bleed-dry.title: Bleed Dry
class-vessel-bleed-dry.text: If this attack kills the target, gain TVG equal to their maximum VG. Your total of VG and TVGgained this way may not exceed your maximum VG.

class-vessel-parasite-pacification.title: Parasite Pacification
class-vessel-parasite-pacification.text: You may choose not to inflict DMG with your hemomancy attacks and cleanse Bleeding equal to its level that would usually be inflicted by the attack. Your hemomancy attacks deal -1 DMG and the Bleeding they inflict to enemies is reduced by 1. You no longer suffer VG and SN penalties from drinking herbal poisons.

class-vessel-vascular-pulse.title: Vascular Pulse
class-vessel-vascular-pulse.text: Inflict Stun 2 to any number of targets inside M or closer. Targets affected by Bleeding suffer additional Stun equal to its level.

class-vessel-rapid-coagulation.title: Rapid Coagulation
class-vessel-rapid-coagulation.text: Triggers on you or ally within M being afflicted by Bleeding. Reduce the level of that effect by 2.

discipline-warfare.title: Warfare
discipline-warfare.text: Slay your foes mercilessly, take their blows head on. Recommended for soldiers, brutes and those wielding heavy melee weapons.
discipline-warfare.tagline: Slay your foes mercilessly, take their blows head on.
discipline-warfare.recommended_for: Recommended for soldiers, brutes and those wielding heavy melee weapons.

discipline-warfare-wide-slash.title: Wide Slash
discipline-warfare-wide-slash.text: This attack may target an additional target adjacent to the original target.

discipline-warfare-advance.title: Advance
discipline-warfare-advance.text: Gain +4 ACC if you have successfully attacked the target since the start of your previous turn. Inflict Stun 1 and Push 1 in any direction.

discipline-warfare-adrenaline-surge.title: Adrenaline Surge
discipline-warfare-adrenaline-surge.text: Reduce your Bleeding by 1. Your next 2H melee attack this turn gains your choice of: ● +1 ACC ● Break 1 ● Stun 1

discipline-warfare-deep-breaths.title: Deep Breaths
discipline-warfare-deep-breaths.text: Heal 4 Strain. Only usable while Strain is higher than half of the maximum SL.

discipline-warfare-charge.title: Charge
discipline-warfare-charge.text: Gain an additional movement action. Knock the target Prone (CL 12 Stance save).

discipline-warfare-whirlwind-cleave.title: Whirlwind Cleave
discipline-warfare-whirlwind-cleave.text: This attack may target up to three targets adjacent to one another. Gain +1 EVA until your next turn for each target.

discipline-warfare-tear-asunder.title: Tear Asunder
discipline-warfare-tear-asunder.text: Inflict Break 3 and Stun equal to the target’s total available armour.

discipline-warfare-leg-sweep.title: Leg Sweep
discipline-warfare-leg-sweep.text: Knock up to two targets Prone (CL 14 Stance save).

discipline-warfare-stand-tall.title: Stand Tall
discipline-warfare-stand-tall.text: Gain 3 TVG. You gain +4 on Stance saves until your next turn.

discipline-warfare-overpower.title: Overpower
discipline-warfare-overpower.text: Triggers on an enemy melee attack not hitting you. Inflict Stun 1 on the target and gain +2 DMG against that target until the end of your next turn.

discipline-warfare-no-quarter.title: No Quarter
discipline-warfare-no-quarter.text: Triggers on enemy leaving your A. Gain an additional movement action that must be used to enter A with that enemy after which you perform this attack.

discipline-warfare-execution.title: Execution
discipline-warfare-execution.text: For each status effect among Stun, Prone and Unaware affecting the target, this attack gains +3 ACC.

discipline-warfare-dismember.title: Dismember
discipline-warfare-dismember.text: If the target has Bleeding higher than 3, this attack deals +8 DMG and dismembers any of their body parts.

discipline-warfare-impale.title: Impale
discipline-warfare-impale.text: Gain an additional movement action. Inflict Pierce 3. This attack deals +2 DMG for each tile of distance between you and your target at the start of your turn.

discipline-warfare-shatter-ego.title: Shatter Ego
discipline-warfare-shatter-ego.text: Inflict Stun 5, Push 2, knock the target Prone and Disarm them (combined CL 16 Stance save).

discipline-warfare-internal-bleeding.title: Internal Bleeding
discipline-warfare-internal-bleeding.text: Inflict Break 3. The target suffers Bleeding equal to the amount of armour points broken by this attack whenever it receives damage up to a total of Bleeding 6 until the end of your next turn.

discipline-duel.title: Duel
discipline-duel.text: Create openings, humiliate your enemies. Recommended for nimble fighters, adventurers and those using light melee weapons.
discipline-duel.recommended_for: Recommended for nimble fighters, adventurers and those using light melee weapons.

discipline-duel-flick.title: Flick
discipline-duel-flick.text: Triggers on enemy attack targeting you missing. If the target missed you by 4 or more, regain your reaction for the turn.

discipline-duel-sidearm-holster.title: Sidearm Holster
discipline-duel-sidearm-holster.text: Holster a melee weapon or shield. Gain +1 EVA until your next turn.

discipline-duel-meditate.title: Meditate
discipline-duel-meditate.text: Heal 2 Strain for each enemy standing in your A.

discipline-duel-exploitation.title: Exploitation
discipline-duel-exploitation.text: Your next attack 1H melee attack this turn gains your choice of the following on stunned targets: ● Bleeding 1 ● Break 1 ● Pierce 2

discipline-duel-maiming-slash.title: Maiming Slash
discipline-duel-maiming-slash.text: Inflict Bleeding 2. The target loses their next movement action. Gains +6 ACC if the target is stunned.

discipline-duel-disarming-strike.title: Disarming Strike
discipline-duel-disarming-strike.text: The target is Disarmed (CL 16 Stance save). Gains +6 ACC if the target is stunned.

discipline-duel-brutal-swing.title: Brutal Swing
discipline-duel-brutal-swing.text: Inflict Pierce 2. Gains +6 ACC if the target is stunned.

discipline-duel-perfect-parry.title: Perfect Parry
discipline-duel-perfect-parry.text: Triggers on enemy attack targeting you missing. Gain +1 AP on your next turn.

discipline-duel-riposte.title: Riposte
discipline-duel-riposte.text: Triggers on enemy attack targeting you.

discipline-duel-kick-down.title: Kick Down
discipline-duel-kick-down.text: If the target is stunned, knock them Prone (CL 14 Stance save). Otherwise, this attack inflicts Stun 2 or Stun 4 if the target used a defensive action during their previous turn.

discipline-duel-issue-challenge.title: Issue Challenge
discipline-duel-issue-challenge.text: Target an enemy within your A. Inflict Taunt on that enemy and gain +1 ACC against them for as long as they remain taunted.

discipline-duel-toppling-sequence.title: Toppling Sequence
discipline-duel-toppling-sequence.text: Until the end of your next two turns, your attacks inflict Stun 2.

discipline-duel-dual-offensive.title: Dual Offensive
discipline-duel-dual-offensive.text: If you are holding two weapons, you may make an additional ranged throw attack with +2 ACC and +1 DMG with no action cost with one of them.

discipline-duel-error-of-their-ways.title: Error of Their Ways
discipline-duel-error-of-their-ways.text: Triggers on enemy attack targeting you missing by 4 or more.

discipline-duel-honorable-end.title: Honorable End
discipline-duel-honorable-end.text: Gains +1 ACC per successful attack you have made against the target in this combat encounter. May only be used once per enemy during that combat encounter

discipline-protection.title: Protection
discipline-protection.text: Become invulnerable, protect the innocent. Recommended for heavy armour users, evasive scoundrels and those hoping to avoid death.
discipline-protection.recommended_for: Recommended for heavy armour users, evasive scoundrels and those hoping to avoid death.

discipline-protection-evasive-footwork.title: Evasive Footwork
discipline-protection-evasive-footwork.text: Gain +1 EVA until your next turn.

discipline-protection-on-guard.title: On Guard
discipline-protection-on-guard.text: Gain 3 TVG that last until your next turn.

discipline-protection-shielded-attack.title: Shielded Attack
discipline-protection-shielded-attack.text: Gains +ACC equal to the sum of armour points and EVA provided by the shield.

discipline-protection-impervious.title: Impervious
discipline-protection-impervious.text: Heal 2 SN for each attack made against you and each attack that does no DMG to you until your next turn. Only heals SN while at half or less of SL.

discipline-protection-elusive-target.title: Elusive Target
discipline-protection-elusive-target.text: Gain EVA equal to your Dexterity/2, rounded down until the end of your turn.

discipline-protection-durable-target.title: Durable Target
discipline-protection-durable-target.text: Your AP are increased by your Endurance/2, rounded down until the end of your turn.

discipline-protection-unpredictable-navi.title: Unpredictable Navigation
discipline-protection-unpredictable-navi.text: Gain +2 tiles of movement on your next movement action. Not usable while wearing medium or heavy armour.

discipline-protection-fortress.title: Fortress
discipline-protection-fortress.text: You and an ally are treated as standing in cover one level higher until your next turn for as long as you are adjacent.

discipline-protection-field-fortificatio.title: Field Fortification
discipline-protection-field-fortificatio.text: Restore 1 AP. You may restore an AP and gain +2 EVA until your next turn if you spend +1 ACP to perform this ability. Not usable without worn armour or a shield that provides AP.

discipline-protection-slip-out.title: Slip Out
discipline-protection-slip-out.text: You cannot be targeted by attackers who haven’t attacked you since your last turn until your next turn. You cannot use this ability on consecutive turns. Not usable while wearing medium or heavy armour.

discipline-protection-intervention.title: Intervention
discipline-protection-intervention.text: Triggers on adjacent enemy attempting to perform an average or slower action. If you have a higher or equal REF, prevent that action.

discipline-protection-safeguard.title: Safeguard
discipline-protection-safeguard.text: Triggers on an ally adjacent to you being hit by an attack. You may redirect that attack to yourself.

discipline-protection-high-stance.title: High Stance
discipline-protection-high-stance.text: Bleeding, Stun and Break you suffer until your next turn are reduced by 3. Taunt a target enemy (CL 14 Willpower save).

discipline-protection-damage-control.title: Damage Control
discipline-protection-damage-control.text: Triggers on an attack dealing DMG to you. Prevent up to half of that DMG rounded down after accounting for armour. This ability is only usable while wearing medium or heavy armour.

discipline-protection-steel-shepard.title: Steel Shepard
discipline-protection-steel-shepard.text: All attacks targeting allies standing within C of you are redirected to you as long as you are adjacent to the attackers or standing between the attackers and your allies.

discipline-protection-split-second-slip.title: Split-Second Slip
discipline-protection-split-second-slip.text: Triggers on an enemy projectile attack targeting you. Gain +4 EVA against that attack. Unusable while wearing medium or heavy armour.

discipline-protection-the-stand.title: The Stand
discipline-protection-the-stand.text: Until your next turn you gain a free reaction melee attack every time an enemy enters your A that has +0 ACC and +0 DMG (This attack does not consume your reaction for the turn).

discipline-protection-shielded-charge.title: Shielded Charge
discipline-protection-shielded-charge.text: Perform a movement action going in a straight line while performing this attack. This attack is made against all targets standing inside the line of movement and the targets are pushed to the sides as they are hit. This attack gains +ACC equal to the sum of armour points and EVA provided by the shield. Lose all shield benefits until your next turn.

discipline-leadership.title: Leadership
discipline-leadership.text: Inspire comrades, push them to their limits. Recommended for officers, activists and all who aim to coordinate their allies.
discipline-leadership.tagline: Inspire comrades, push them to their limits.
discipline-leadership.recommended_for: Recommended for officers, activists and all who aim to coordinate their allies.

discipline-leadership-inspire.title: Inspire
discipline-leadership-inspire.text: Triggers on any allied roll and costs 1 ACP. Make an Intuition check with a CL equal to that roll and add +2 to the target roll if you succeed.

discipline-leadership-stand-order.title: Stand Order
discipline-leadership-stand-order.text: Target up to 3 allies. If they use a melee attack during their next turn, they gain +3 EVA for 1 turn.

discipline-leadership-amplify.title: Amplify
discipline-leadership-amplify.text: Double the effects of your channeled abilities from instruments until your next turn.

discipline-leadership-combat-march.title: /> Combat March
discipline-leadership-combat-march.text: Allies within your M gain +1 ACC.

discipline-leadership-volley-order.title: Volley Order
discipline-leadership-volley-order.text: Target up to 3 allies. If they don’t use an attack during their next turn, they gain +3 ACC and +2 DMG on their next ranged attack and it costs 1 SN less to perform.

discipline-leadership-strike-order.title: Strike Order
discipline-leadership-strike-order.text: Target up to 3 allies. During their next turn, their melee attacks may cost 2 less SN to perform and gain +2 ACC. If they do, any enemies flanking them deal +DMG equal to the ACC bonus from flanking to them until the end of their next turn.

discipline-leadership-focused-melody.title: />> Focused Melody
discipline-leadership-focused-melody.text: Allies within your M gain +3 on all non-combat rolls. Also costs 1 destiny point to upkeep.

discipline-leadership-echoing-elegy.title: /> Echoing Elegy
discipline-leadership-echoing-elegy.text: Enemies within your M suffer 2 SN per round.

discipline-leadership-fallback-order.title: Fallback Order
discipline-leadership-fallback-order.text: Target up to 3 allies. If they move away from their closest enemy during their next turn they gain +1 Tile of movement during that movement action and gain +4 EVA until the end of their next turn.

discipline-leadership-conservation-order.title: Conservation Order
discipline-leadership-conservation-order.text: Target up to 3 allies. If they don’t use any abilities with a SN cost during their next turn they heal 4 SN up to half of their SL at the end of that turn.

discipline-leadership-alluring-aria.title: />> Alluring Aria
discipline-leadership-alluring-aria.text: Inflict Pull 1 to enemies within your M and Stun 1 to enemies within your C per round.

discipline-leadership-radiant-resonance.title: />> Radiant Resonance
discipline-leadership-radiant-resonance.text: Inflict Push 1 to enemies within your M and Burn 2 to enemies within your C per round.

discipline-leadership-pinpoint-order.title: Pinpoint Order
discipline-leadership-pinpoint-order.text: Target up to 3 allies and an enemy. If all allies target that enemy with abilities during this round, the last ally to do this gains a temporary destiny point that lasts until the end of the round and gains +4 ACC and +2 DMG on the ability if it was an attack.

discipline-leadership-aegis-order.title: Aegis Order
discipline-leadership-aegis-order.text: Target up to 3 allies and another creature. Each ally who interacts with the chosen creature using an ability or ends their turn in their A gives them +3 EVA for 1 turn.

discipline-leadership-violent-verse.title: />> Violent Verse
discipline-leadership-violent-verse.text: Enemies suffer DMG while inside of specific ranges from you: A-C: 5 DMG M: 3 DMG L: 1 DMG

discipline-leadership-hymn-of-hope.title: />> Hymn of Hope
