discipline-leadership-hymn-of-hope.text: Allies heal 5 SN when this ability is first used or 2 SN on subsequent turns while it remains channeled if they are inside of your M.

discipline-leadership-gamble.title: Gamble
discipline-leadership-gamble.text: Your Leadership orders this turn provide double bonuses, but those who follow them suffer -4 EVA while under their effects unless they spend a destiny point.

discipline-leadership-tactical-mastery.title: Tactical Mastery
discipline-leadership-tactical-mastery.text: You may perform a second Leadership order this turn at 0 ACP cost. It must target the same allies and they must achieve the conditions for both orders to get their benefits.

discipline-leadership-cacophony.title: Cacophony
discipline-leadership-cacophony.text: Activate all of your active channeled abilities that use an instrument at once for a single turn. Stop channeling all abilities at the end of your turn.

discipline-leadership-ode-to-the-observe.title: /> Ode to The Observer
discipline-leadership-ode-to-the-observe.text: You and allies within your M gain 1 temporary destiny point that lasts until your next turn.

discipline-shadow.title: Shadow
discipline-shadow.text: Strike from the shadows, win by any means. Recommended for assassins, cutthroats and shady gadgeteers.
discipline-shadow.tagline: Strike from the shadows, win by any means.
discipline-shadow.recommended_for: Recommended for assassins, cutthroats and shady gadgeteers.

discipline-shadow-bump-in-the-dark.title: Bump in The Dark
discipline-shadow-bump-in-the-dark.text: This attack gains +3 DMG and inflicts Pierce 2 against Unaware targets.

discipline-shadow-hunker-down.title: Hunker Down
discipline-shadow-hunker-down.text: If no enemy targets you until your next turn, you enter Stealth.

discipline-shadow-ambush-shot.title: Ambush Shot
discipline-shadow-ambush-shot.text: This attack gains +3 ACC and +3 DMG against Unaware targets.

discipline-shadow-lunge.title: Lunge
discipline-shadow-lunge.text: This attack gains +4 ACC and inflicts Pierce 3 against Flanked and Unaware targets.

discipline-shadow-insidious-plot.title: Insidious Plot
discipline-shadow-insidious-plot.text: Your next attack that uses Stealth weapons gains +2 ACC and +2 DMG

discipline-shadow-moment-of-reprieve.title: Moment of Reprieve
discipline-shadow-moment-of-reprieve.text: Only usable while in Stealth. Restore 4 SN if your current SN is higher than half of your SL.

discipline-shadow-opportunistic-angle.title: Opportunistic Angle
discipline-shadow-opportunistic-angle.text: This attack gains +3 ACC and inflicts Stun 2 against Flanked and Unaware targets.

discipline-shadow-sacrificial-stab.title: Sacrificial Stab
discipline-shadow-sacrificial-stab.text: You suffer -3 EVA against melee attacks until your next turn.

discipline-shadow-lay-to-rest.title: Lay to Rest
discipline-shadow-lay-to-rest.text: This attack gains +2 ACC and +10 DMG against Unaware targets. Only usable against targets who have entered combat this round.

discipline-shadow-familiar-tricks.title: Familiar Tricks
discipline-shadow-familiar-tricks.text: Triggers on you being afflicted by Stun. Reduce the level of that effect by 2.

discipline-shadow-entrenched-position.title: Entrenched Position
discipline-shadow-entrenched-position.text: Gain +2 EVA against ranged attacks from a target you attacked with a ranged attack this turn.

discipline-shadow-daylight-robbery.title: Daylight Robbery
discipline-shadow-daylight-robbery.text: Disarm the target and equip their weapon in your offhand if possible (CL 10 Stance save). The Stance save’s CL is 13 if the target is Flanked or 16 if the target is Unaware.

discipline-shadow-veil-of-violence.title: Veil of Violence
discipline-shadow-veil-of-violence.text: Enter Stealth if all enemies who targeted you since your previous turn are incapacitated or dead.

discipline-shadow-grim-satisfaction.title: Grim Satisfaction
discipline-shadow-grim-satisfaction.text: Restore 3 SN if you have killed or incapacitated an enemy while in Stealth this turn.

discipline-shadow-hidden-talent.title: Hidden Talent
discipline-shadow-hidden-talent.text: The next attack you perform this turn gains +4 ACC if it uses a weapon type other than Stealth and if you haven’t used that weapon type before during this combat encounter.

discipline-shadow-follow-up-execution.title: Follow-up Execution
discipline-shadow-follow-up-execution.text: This attack gains +8 ACC and inflicts Pierce 4 against targets that are Flanked and have been successfully attacked by your allies since your last turn.

discipline-shadow-murderous-frenzy.title: Murderous Frenzy
discipline-shadow-murderous-frenzy.text: Triggers on you incapacitating or killing an enemy. Gain 2 ACP. You may repeat abilities this turn.

discipline-shadow-gone-and-forgotten.title: Gone and Forgotten
discipline-shadow-gone-and-forgotten.text: Triggers on enemy melee attack targeting you missing. You gain an additional movement and immediately use it. If you get out of the line of sight of all enemies, you enter Stealth.

discipline-shadow-feign-death.title: Feign Death
discipline-shadow-feign-death.text: Until your next turn, the next time you are targeted by an enemy attack you collapse, appear incapacitated to other enemies and enter Stealth. Your next attack against a Flanked or Unaware enemy during your next turn gains +5 ACC and +5 DMG.

discipline-precision.title: Precision
discipline-precision.text: Eliminate from afar, oversee the battlefield. Recommended for archers, gunners and all those looking to rain down volleys of projectiles upon their foes.
discipline-precision.tagline: Eliminate from afar, oversee the battlefield.
discipline-precision.recommended_for: Recommended for archers, gunners and all those looking to rain down volleys of projectiles upon their foes.

discipline-precision-steady-shot.title: Steady Shot
discipline-precision-steady-shot.text: You cannot use this ability if you have moved this turn and you cannot move this turn after using this ability.

discipline-precision-pin-down.title: Pin Down
discipline-precision-pin-down.text: The target cannot move during their next turn (CL 12 Stance save). Inflict Stun 1.

discipline-precision-take-aim.title: Take Aim
discipline-precision-take-aim.text: Gain +2 ACC on your next ranged attack this turn.

discipline-precision-swift-reload.title: Swift Reload
discipline-precision-swift-reload.text: Reload or holster a ranged weapon. Your next ranged attack gains +1 ACC.

discipline-precision-point-blank-shot.title: Point Blank Shot
discipline-precision-point-blank-shot.text: Must be performed at A range. Gains +4 ACC if the target is stunned.

discipline-precision-suppressing-fire.title: />> Suppressing Fire
discipline-precision-suppressing-fire.text: The target suffers -2 EVA and -2 on all rolls until your next turn.

discipline-precision-perfect-alignment.title: Perfect Alignment
discipline-precision-perfect-alignment.text: Your next ranged attack until the end of your next turn gains +2 ACC, inflicts Pierce 1 and restores 4 SN if you have more than half of your SL.

discipline-precision-trickshot.title: Trickshot
discipline-precision-trickshot.text: Take a ricochet shot that ignores the target’s cover (the shot still must be theoretically possible). Inflict Pierce 2.

discipline-precision-last-line.title: Last Line
discipline-precision-last-line.text: Triggers on an enemy entering your A range.

discipline-precision-clutch-shot.title: Clutch Shot
discipline-precision-clutch-shot.text: This attack may not be used more than once per combat encounter. This attack may not inflict additional DMG from ACC overflow.

discipline-precision-fan-fire.title: Fan Fire
discipline-precision-fan-fire.text: Inflict Stun 1. Repeat this attack twice.

discipline-precision-rapid-fire.title: Rapid Fire
discipline-precision-rapid-fire.text: Inflict Pierce 1 and Break 1. This attack repeats once.

discipline-precision-skewer.title: Skewer
discipline-precision-skewer.text: Inflict Bleeding 2. Repeat this attack twice on the same target.

discipline-precision-seeking-missile.title: Seeking Missile
discipline-precision-seeking-missile.text: Whenever you perform this attack it gains +2 DMG and inflicts Pierce 1 the next time you use it during your next turn. This bonus stacks and refreshes with each use and is lost when the target is incapacitated or killed.

discipline-echo.title: Echo
discipline-echo.text: Exploit the past, animate constructs. Recommended for explorers of memory shards, roboticists and ambedo experts.
discipline-echo.recommended_for: Recommended for explorers of memory shards, roboticists and ambedo experts.

discipline-echo-past-insight.title: Past Insight
discipline-echo-past-insight.text: Delve into an available static memory and re-experience it.

discipline-echo-mind-glimpse.title: Mind Glimpse
discipline-echo-mind-glimpse.text: Take a short peek at the target’s current thoughts. The target becomes Analyzed.

discipline-echo-construct-command.title: Construct Command
discipline-echo-construct-command.text: Give a construct you are paired with a Movement action or 2 AP.

discipline-echo-undivided-attention.title: Undivided Attention
discipline-echo-undivided-attention.text: Give a construct you are paired with a Movement action or 2 ACP.

discipline-echo-archive-review.title: Archive Review
discipline-echo-archive-review.text: Gain +2 on your next INT roll outside of combat. This effect persists for 10 minutes and doesn’t stack.

discipline-echo-frequency-shift.title: Frequency Shift
discipline-echo-frequency-shift.text: Gain +2 on all rolls during your next memory delve. Lasts for 10 minutes and does not stack.

discipline-echo-evasion-protocol.title: Evasion Protocol
discipline-echo-evasion-protocol.text: Give a construct you are paired with +2 EVA until your next turn.

discipline-echo-harm-protocol.title: Harm Protocol
discipline-echo-harm-protocol.text: Give a construct you are paired with +2 DMG until your next turn.

discipline-echo-memory-intrusion.title: Memory Intrusion
discipline-echo-memory-intrusion.text: Forcefully analyze a target’s memory that you are aware of (Opposed Eidoloscope vs Willpower save).

discipline-echo-reality-tether.title: Reality Tether
discipline-echo-reality-tether.text: Roll all saving throws during your next memory delve with advantage. Lasts for 10 minutes.

discipline-echo-destruction-command.title: Destruction Command
discipline-echo-destruction-command.text: Give a construct you are paired with +2 ACP, +1 DMG dealt and +1 to all status effects inflicted until your next turn. Make a CL 14 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

discipline-echo-relocation-command.title: Relocation Command
discipline-echo-relocation-command.text: Give a construct you are paired with 2 movement actions. Make a CL 14 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

discipline-echo-silent-intrusion.title: Silent Intrusion
discipline-echo-silent-intrusion.text: Secretly analyze a target’s memory that you are aware of (Opposed Eidoloscope vs Perception save). The ability fails and the target becomes aware of the attempt upon failure.

discipline-echo-assistive-link.title: Assistive Link
discipline-echo-assistive-link.text: Use your eidoloscope to mentally tether to a willing creature. Both of you may use the skill scores of the other for rolling any non-combat roll at the cost of 5 SN. Lasts for 10 minutes.

discipline-echo-mutual-destruction.title: Mutual Destruction
discipline-echo-mutual-destruction.text: Until your next turn, whenever a construct you are paired with inflicts DMG to an enemy it may deplete up to that much of its armour points and inflict that much break to the enemy. It may also deplete its VG in order to add that much DMG to the next attack that turn. Make a CL 16 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

discipline-echo-purify-signal.title: / | Purify Signal
discipline-echo-purify-signal.text: Give a construct you are paired with +2 ACC. It can not inflict additional DMG from ACC overflow while this ability is being channeled. Upon casting, make a CL 16 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

discipline-echo-memory-insertion.title: Memory Insertion
discipline-echo-memory-insertion.text: Secretly alter a target’s memory that you have delved into or implant an entirely manufactured one (Opposed Eidoloscope vs Perception save). If the ability fails the target becomes aware of the attempt.

discipline-echo-ambedic-imprint.title: Ambedic Imprint
discipline-echo-ambedic-imprint.text: Record and imprint the memory you are currently inside of onto an empty ambedic shard.

discipline-echo-consciousness-exertion.title: Consciousness Exertion
discipline-echo-consciousness-exertion.text: Until your next turn, you may perform abilities that grant AP to your linked constructs at no AP cost but at 3 Strain cost per AP granted. Make a CL 18 Engineering check. On a failure, the construct suffers a Glitch.

discipline-echo-perceptive-anomaly.title: Perceptive Anomaly
discipline-echo-perceptive-anomaly.text: Fuse your mind with your linked construct completely, redirecting effects that would affect it to yourself. Until your next turn, all DMG and status effects that construct would suffer are redirected to you instead. You gain a temporary destiny point for each ability you redirect to yourself this way.

discipline-zeal.title: Zeal
discipline-zeal.text: Profess your convictions, evoke your Season. Recommended for zealous paragons, powerful sorcerers and all those looking to enact their Season upon the world.
discipline-zeal.tagline: Profess your convictions, evoke your Season.
discipline-zeal.recommended_for: Recommended for zealous paragons, powerful sorcerers and all those looking to enact their Season upon the world.

discipline-zeal-vital-attunement.title: Vital Attunement
discipline-zeal-vital-attunement.text: Conviction: Halice You add a target creature to your network of Attunement and heal SN equal to the number of creatures you are attuned to if your SN is higher than or equal to half of your SL, rounded down. You remain attuned to the creature for up to 1 hour.

discipline-zeal-warp-flesh.title: Warp Flesh
discipline-zeal-warp-flesh.text: Conviction: Halice Inflict Bleeding 1. If targeting an armored target, all other effects and DMG of the attack are negated and it inflicts Break 1 instead. Requires Attunement.

discipline-zeal-wither.title: Wither
discipline-zeal-wither.text: Conviction: Halice Inflict Feeble 2 and Stun 1. Requires Attunement.

discipline-zeal-realign-biomass.title: Realign Biomass
discipline-zeal-realign-biomass.text: Conviction: Halice Target yourself or someone you can physically touch and are Attuned to. The target heals 2d6 HP and is cleansed of Bleeding. They suffer Stun 1.

discipline-zeal-bodily-sculpting.title: Bodily Sculpting
discipline-zeal-bodily-sculpting.text: Conviction: Halice Create a new body part of any shape which may be attached to a living creature or reshape an existing body part. Requires sufficient compatible biomass to function. For example, a human arm made of leaves would not be able to sustain itself while attached to a human, something more adjacent like animal flesh would be required. Similarly, rotten or diseased flesh would likely cause a lot of harm should it be reshaped into an organ and attached to a living creature.

discipline-zeal-scorch.title: Scorch
discipline-zeal-scorch.text: Conviction: Vamor Suffer Soulburn 1. Inflict Burn 2.

discipline-zeal-flame-pylon.title: Flame Pylon
discipline-zeal-flame-pylon.text: Conviction: Vamor Suffer Soulburn 1. A burning target and all enemies within its A suffer Burn equal to your Soulburn.

discipline-zeal-extinguish.title: Extinguish
discipline-zeal-extinguish.text: Conviction: Vamor Fully cleanse your Soulburn and gain +EVA equal to its rank until your next turn.

discipline-zeal-virulent-combustion.title: Virulent Combustion
discipline-zeal-virulent-combustion.text: Conviction: Vamor This attack can chain to enemies within C, including those it has already hit. The number of times it can chain is limited to your soulburn rank. Inflict Burn 2.

discipline-zeal-heartburn.title: />>> Heartburn
discipline-zeal-heartburn.text: Conviction: Vamor This attack gains +4 ACC on burning targets. Every turn that this attack is channeled, you suffer Soulburn 1 and you inflict Burn equal to your soulburn rank on your target. If the attack is successful on the initial cast, it will continue to successfully hit on the following turns regardless of rolls. Damage that would be inflicted through ACC overflow is instead converted to additional Burn.

discipline-zeal-ghostly-flicker.title: Ghostly Flicker
discipline-zeal-ghostly-flicker.text: Conviction: Bruma This ability inflicts SN instead of DMG. If SN would go over the target’s SL the ability also deals equal DMG and inflicts Stun 2.

discipline-zeal-disrupt-mind.title: Disrupt Mind
discipline-zeal-disrupt-mind.text: Conviction: Bruma The target cannot repeat any actions they used during their previous turn (CL 14 Willpower save). Inflict Stun 3.

discipline-zeal-asylum.title: Asylum
discipline-zeal-asylum.text: Conviction: Bruma Heal any amount of SN from allies within your M. You suffer that much SN divided by 2 and rounded down.

discipline-zeal-eclipse.title: Eclipse
discipline-zeal-eclipse.text: Conviction: Bruma Temporarily suppress the consciousness of a creature strongly enough it disappears from reality for one combat round. Only usable on creatures with half or more of their SL who were not targeted by this ability last round.

discipline-zeal-void-anchor.title: /> Void Anchor
discipline-zeal-void-anchor.text: Conviction: Bruma This ability inflicts SN instead of DMG. If SN would go over the target’s SL the ability also deals equal DMG and inflicts Stun 1. Suppress consciousness in a M radius around you. Perform as a regular attack upon using the ability. While channeled on later turns, the ability acts as an aura that inflicts 3 SN to your enemies within its range for every round they spend within it.

discipline-zeal-compress-matter.title: Compress Matter
discipline-zeal-compress-matter.text: Conviction: Trumst Move your Mass Origin (MO) to the location of your target and Inflict Break 1. If the MO is already on your target, this attack inflicts DMG.

discipline-zeal-lockdown.title: Lockdown
discipline-zeal-lockdown.text: Conviction: Trumst If your MO is on the target, they are unable to move until your next turn and suffer Stun 2. Otherwise, this ability costs 1 ACP and you move your MO onto the target and have it follow them until your next turn.

discipline-zeal-repulse.title: Repulse
discipline-zeal-repulse.text: Conviction: Trumst Inflict Push 2 in any direction on all targets within C of your MO. The targets suffer Stun 2 and 1 DMG that ignores armour if they would hit something or are instead knocked Prone (Cl 12 Stance save) if they end up in an empty space.

discipline-zeal-spatial-anomaly.title: /> Spatial Anomaly
discipline-zeal-spatial-anomaly.text: Conviction: Trumst You may move your MO to a place you can see within your M upon casting this ability. Inflict Stun 1 and Pull 1 towards your MO on all enemies within C of it every turn this ability remains channeled.

discipline-zeal-pressure-absolute.title: Pressure Absolute
discipline-zeal-pressure-absolute.text: Conviction: Trumst May target any number of targets within M for +2 SN for each target beyond the first. For each target choose Lift or Bend. They are affected by this ability until your next turn. Your MO disappears after performing this ability. Lift: The enemy is lifted a single tile above ground and held in place, suffering -5 EVA. Inflict Stun 2. Bend: The enemy is crushed by pressure from above and held in place Prone. Inflict Break 2.

discipline-mysticism.title: Mysticism
discipline-mysticism.text: Ponder your ideals, reshape the world. Recommended for cryptic mages, wise shamans and all those with an interest for the occult aspects of Seasons.
discipline-mysticism.tagline: Ponder your ideals, reshape the world.
discipline-mysticism.recommended_for: Recommended for cryptic mages, wise shamans and all those with an interest for the occult aspects of Seasons.

discipline-mysticism-parting-commune.title: Parting Commune
discipline-mysticism-parting-commune.text: Conviction: Halice Reanimate a creature that died in the last 5 minutes. It will persist in a delirious state for 1d6 minutes during which it can answer simple questions. It cannot move on its own. After the ability’s duration the creature permanently dies and cannot be reanimated again.

discipline-mysticism-raise-zombie.title: Raise Zombie
discipline-mysticism-raise-zombie.text: Conviction: Halice Reanimate and control a creature whose body is somewhat intact. It can perform basic abilities, its EVA is halved and rounded down and it deals -1 DMG. The creature will persist for a number of rounds equal to its max VG/2, rounded down or until you use this ability again.

discipline-mysticism-puppeteer.title: Puppeteer
discipline-mysticism-puppeteer.text: Conviction: Halice Triggers on an enemy with more than half of their SL performing an ability. You may change the targets of that ability if it has them, and you may spend the target’s movement action or make them use a free movement action before doing so.

discipline-mysticism-revenant.title: Revenant
discipline-mysticism-revenant.text: Conviction: Halice Reanimate and control a fresh creature with a somewhat intact body. It can perform any abilities it once knew, its EVA, DMG and all other rolls are reduced by 1 for each point of VG it had under 0 when it died. The creature persists indefinitely or until the caster creates a new revenant.

discipline-mysticism-final-safeguard.title: Final Safeguard
discipline-mysticism-final-safeguard.text: Conviction: Halice Triggers on you or any other creature suffering damage that would kill it or otherwise put its VG below 0. Use your mastery of the flesh to anchor the soul of the target to their body for a bit longer, healing them back to 0 VG and bypassing any death’s door checks. This ability may be performed without using up a reaction if its user suffers +5 SN.

discipline-mysticism-vital-burst.title: Vital Burst
discipline-mysticism-vital-burst.text: Conviction: Vamor Add +2 ACC to your next attack or gain 2 TVG.

discipline-mysticism-cauterize.title: Cauterize
discipline-mysticism-cauterize.text: Conviction: Vamor Cleanse all Bleeding and restore 1 VG to a target within your C. For targets below half of their maximum VG or yourself, also restore VG equal to your class rank plus the rank of Bleeding this ability cleansed.

discipline-mysticism-blazing-armaments.title: Blazing Armaments
discipline-mysticism-blazing-armaments.text: Conviction: Vamor Your weapons inflict Burn 2 for the next 3 attacks you perform.

discipline-mysticism-firefly.title: Firefly
discipline-mysticism-firefly.text: Conviction: Vamor You gain +2 Tiles of movement until your next turn and inflict Burn 1 on those you pass by in A during this period.

discipline-mysticism-living-torch.title: Living Torch
discipline-mysticism-living-torch.text: Conviction: Vamor Reduce your VG to 1. Your next attack gains +10 ACC and inflicts Burn 5 and you are immune to DMG until you perform it or until the end of your next turn, whichever happens sooner. If used outside of combat, you may immediately perform any roll with a +6 bonus but you are reduced to 0 VG after the roll. Requires VG above 1.

discipline-mysticism-telepathy.title: Telepathy
discipline-mysticism-telepathy.text: Conviction: Bruma Convey a short message to a creature within 1km.

discipline-mysticism-fate-sliver.title: Fate Sliver
discipline-mysticism-fate-sliver.text: Conviction: Bruma Roll 1d6 and note down the result. You may exchange that die with any other die of a roll you witness during that day. Usable once per day.

discipline-mysticism-bound-assistance.title: Bound Assistance
discipline-mysticism-bound-assistance.text: Conviction: Bruma This ability additionally costs 1 Destiny Point if it has already been used this day. Summon a soul from the void to perform one of the following: Rupture: Explode in a 2x2 tile area you can see, dealing 3 DMG and inflicting Burn 2. Obscure: Give a creature you can see +4 EVA until your next turn. Bestow: You gain a temporary Destiny Point that lasts for a day that cannot be used to upgrade Convictions.

discipline-mysticism-deep-attunement.title: Deep Attunement
discipline-mysticism-deep-attunement.text: Conviction: Bruma Triggers on you or an ally you see using a Destiny Point to gain a Conviction bonus on a roll. Double the Conviction bonus on that roll.

discipline-mysticism-martyrdom.title: Martyrdom
discipline-mysticism-martyrdom.text: Conviction: Bruma Reduce the Failing of a target by any number of ranks by spending 2 Destiny Points per rank of the Failing. You may reduce the ranks without paying the DP cost by increasing one of your Failings by that many ranks.

discipline-mysticism-remote-observation.title: Remote Observation
discipline-mysticism-remote-observation.text: Conviction: Trumst Take control of a nearby Observer in a high place and survey the region surrounding you. You gain +2 to all rolls concerning navigation while within that area.

discipline-mysticism-surveillance.title: Surveillance
discipline-mysticism-surveillance.text: Conviction: Trumst Take control of a nearby Observer for 1 minute and survey a nearby location. You gain +2 to all rolls concerning navigation and stealth while within that area.

discipline-mysticism-watcher-s-summons.title: Watcher’s Summons
discipline-mysticism-watcher-s-summons.text: Conviction: Trumst This ability additionally costs 1 Destiny Point if it has already been used this day. Summon a nearby Observer to perform one of the following: Blind: The Observer attacks its target’s eyes, making them suffer -4 ACC during their next 2 turns. Distract: The Observer distracts the target who performs a CL 16 Willpower check and becomes Unaware until their next turn if they don’t succeed. Wound: The Observer uses its metal claws in an attempt to wound the target, inflicting Bleeding equal to your highest Trumst Conviction rank.

discipline-mysticism-suffocating-omen.title: /> Suffocating Omen
discipline-mysticism-suffocating-omen.text: Conviction: Trumst Several nearby Observers arrange themselves in a cross pattern above a 4x4 tile area. For as long as this ability remains channeled, the creatures within its area have their movement speed capped at 1 tile and suffer Feeble 3.

discipline-mysticism-transcendent-messen.title: Transcendent Messenger
discipline-mysticism-transcendent-messen.text: Conviction: Trumst Take control of an Observer in any area you are familiar with for 5 minutes. You may speak through the Observer.

discipline-beast.title: Beast
discipline-beast.text: Abandon self, unleash nightmares. Recommended for parasite hosts, cursed wretches and otherworldly individuals.
discipline-beast.recommended_for: Recommended for parasite hosts, cursed wretches and otherworldly individuals.

discipline-beast-bloodletting.title: Bloodletting
discipline-beast-bloodletting.text: Lose 1 VG. Gain +2 ACC on your next attack.

discipline-beast-manifest-flesh.title: Manifest Flesh
discipline-beast-manifest-flesh.text: above rank 1 Costs 1 DP to perform. Create one of the following attached to your body: ● Arm: gain +2 ACC ● Leg: gain +1 Tile of Movement Speed and +1 EVA ● Other Body Part: grants a Narrator defined skill bonus The effects of this ability last for 10 minutes or 3 combat rounds.

discipline-beast-blindspot.title: Blindspot
discipline-beast-blindspot.text: above rank 1 Triggers on getting hit by an ability with a Conviction requirement. Nullify the effects of that ability.

discipline-beast-open-wounds.title: Open Wounds
discipline-beast-open-wounds.text: If the target doesn’t have full VG, inflict Bleeding 2.

discipline-beast-mend-leaks.title: Mend Leaks
discipline-beast-mend-leaks.text: Decrease your level of Bleeding by 2 and heal 2 VG.

discipline-beast-manifest-matter.title: Manifest Matter
discipline-beast-manifest-matter.text: above rank 1 Costs 1 DP to perform. Create any item, weapon or piece of armour you are fully familiar with. Lasts for 10 minutes or until separated from the ability user.

discipline-beast-apparition.title: Apparition
discipline-beast-apparition.text: Costs 1 DP to perform. Until your next turn, enemies suffer 4 SN upon targeting you with an ability.

discipline-beast-feast.title: Feast
discipline-beast-feast.text: Heal VG equal to the target’s Bleeding level and reduce it by 1.

discipline-beast-rapid-bloodflow.title: Rapid Bloodflow
discipline-beast-rapid-bloodflow.text: Deal +DMG equal to the target’s Bleeding and reduce it by 1.

discipline-beast-transmogrify.title: Transmogrify
discipline-beast-transmogrify.text: above rank 1 Costs 2 DP to perform. Warp the shape and physical properties of yourself or an object you touch for 10 minutes or 3 combat rounds.

discipline-beast-channel-entropy.title: Channel Entropy
discipline-beast-channel-entropy.text: Costs 1 DP to perform. Gain 2 temporary destiny points that last until the end of combat.

discipline-beast-blood-lash.title: Blood Lash
discipline-beast-blood-lash.text: Inflict Stun 2. If the target has no armour points, inflict Blind 1.

discipline-beast-essence-exchange.title: Essence Exchange
discipline-beast-essence-exchange.text: Lose any amount of VG and heal twice as much SN.

discipline-beast-edge-mirror.title: Edge Mirror
discipline-beast-edge-mirror.text: This ability targets all enemies within your M. All creatures within your A also suffer Fractured 2. If you have Convictions above the rank of 1 you also suffer the ability’s effects.

discipline-beast-personal-domain.title: Personal Domain
discipline-beast-personal-domain.text: above rank 1 Until your next turn, all DMG you would suffer is instead turned into SN.

discipline-beast-crimson-rot.title: Crimson Rot
discipline-beast-crimson-rot.text: Inflict Bleeding 3. The target’s bleeding cannot be reduced by non-hemomancy means for 2 rounds. Gains +4 ACC against targets with Bleeding 2 or more and +2 ACC against stunned targets.

discipline-beast-eruption.title: Eruption
discipline-beast-eruption.text: Deals damage to the target and all creatures within C. Inflict Bleeding 2 only to the target.

discipline-beast-ego-death.title: Ego Death
discipline-beast-ego-death.text: above rank 1 Exchange your current SN and VG. Increase one of your failings by 1 rank. The failing rank cost increases by 1 on each repeated use in an encounter.

discipline-beast-soul-projection.title: Soul Projection
discipline-beast-soul-projection.text: above rank 1 Inflict Fractured 3 on all creatures within your M. While standing inside of that area for 3 rounds you have double ACP and gain a number of temporary destiny points equal to your DP limit on each of your turns. Increase one of your failings by 4 ranks.
